title: Ep 37 — The Big Three Talk Safety Pacts, and the AI Colouring-Book Business Clearing Seventeen Grand a Month
description: OpenAI's Sam Altman rules out an IPO this year citing safety concerns, an anonymously sourced report has Anthropic eyeing an October Nasdaq listing near two trillion dollars, and all three major labs reportedly discuss a joint pre-release testing body. Plus a deep dive on Low Content AI, a Stripe-verified AI publishing business clearing seventeen and a half thousand dollars a month, and a twentieth straight quiet episode for EV-Partnerships' sports-venue charging gap.
